compiler_only_output.reason: Several members declare Vector3 locals, so this TU re-emits Vector3's vague-linkage D1 alongside its own text. The cartridge keeps one copy at arm9:0x020072c0 and an enrolled source already owns it; rombuild compares this object's body against those cartridge bytes and refuses anything but byte-identical vague-linkage output before discarding the duplicate.

partial_isolation.reason: The final intact TU replaces all 24 legacy shards and lets mwccarm synthesize the ROM-order D1/D0 pair. There is no truthful per-function legacy-object comparison for the synthesized destructors or the newly joined factory; intact whole-object link and data verification is the production proof.
